title: Open the register with a cash in
text: Cash In records the money placed in the drawer at the start of a shift.
steps: Go to Point of Sale to open the register.
Click More Options > Cash-in/Cash-out.
Click Add Cash and enter the amount and reason.
Click Save. The entry appears in the Records tab.

title: Make a sale
text: Add products to the cart, check the items and quantities, then take payment.
steps: Go to Point of Sale to open the register.
Scan a barcode, or search for a product in the search bar and press Enter to add it.
To change the quantity, select the cart item and click Quantity.
To remove an item, select it and click Delete. Use Clear All to empty the cart.
Click Payment when the cart is ready.

title: Give a discount, including Senior Citizen or PWD
text: Apply a percentage or fixed discount to one item or the whole cart. Senior Citizen and PWD discounts come from the selected customer.
steps: Select a cart item for an item discount, or select nothing for a cart discount.
Click Discount.
Choose Percentage or Fixed Amount, enter the value, and click Apply.
If the discount exceeds the store limit, a manager must approve it with a password.
For Senior Citizen or PWD, click Customer and select the person. The discount applies automatically.
To set up customer types or change their rates, go to Settings > Charges & Discounts. Update the customer type on the Customers page.
Make sure the product is eligible for the discount. The Store cannot change government discount rates.

title: Select a customer and use loyalty points
text: Select a customer to apply their discounts, points, and credit to the sale.
steps: On the register, click Customer.
Search for the customer by name or scan their loyalty card.
Click Points to view their points and balance.
At payment, choose Points/Balance to use their points.
The customer earns points automatically after the sale is paid.

title: Take payment in cash, card, or e-wallet
text: Record Payment lets you choose how the customer pays. Cash automatically shows the change.
steps: On the register, click Record Payment.
Choose Cash and enter the amount received. The change appears automatically.
For card, GCash, Maya, or another method, select it and enter a reference number.
Press Enter or click Confirm Payment. The receipt prints and the cart clears.

title: Split a payment across two methods
text: Split payment lets a customer pay with two payment methods. The balance stays open until the full amount is paid.
steps: On the register, click Payment.
Choose the first payment method, enter the amount, and confirm. The remaining balance stays on screen.
Choose the second method and pay the remaining balance. Change is given only when the last method is cash.
Click Clear All to remove the payment parts and start again.

title: Charge a sale to a customer account
text: The Unpaid method completes the sale while the customer still owes money. The balance stays on the customer's account until it is paid.
steps: On the POS, click Customer and select a named customer.
Click Payment > Unpaid.
Choose the due date and confirm. The receipt prints as usual.
To collect payment later, go to More Options > Unpaid Orders, select the customer, and click Confirm Payment.

title: See the list of customers who still owe
text: Unpaid Orders lists every customer with a balance and each receipt they still owe on.
steps: Click Sidebar > Point of Sale.
Click More Options, then Unpaid Orders.
Search by customer name, or scroll. Each row shows the balance still due.
Click a customer to see their unpaid receipts, the total paid, and the balance.
For a printable list, click Sidebar > Reporting > Open Receivables (Unpaid Sales) or Customer Receivables Summary.

title: Collect a payment on a customer's unpaid receipt
text: Use Unpaid Orders to collect part or all of a customer's balance.
steps: Go to Point of Sale > More Options > Unpaid Orders.
Find and select the customer.
Click Pay for one receipt, or click Pay All to settle the full balance.
Enter the amount and choose the payment method. Do not enter more than the balance.
Confirm the payment. The balance updates immediately.

title: Save an order and pick it up later
text: Save Order parks the cart under a name. Serve someone else, then come back to it.
steps: On the register, Click Save Order.
Type a name for the order. Click Save. The cart clears.
To bring it back, click Save Order, then Pending Orders. Or scan the order slip.
Click the order, then click Select Order. Or double-click it. It loads into the cart.
To Delete the save order, click Save Order and choose the name of the customer,  then click Delete. It cannot be undone.

title: Find and reprint a past sale
text: Sales History shows past receipts. You can reprint, refund, or cancel a sale there.
steps: Click Sidebar > Point of Sale.
Click More Options > View Sales History.
Scan the receipt barcode, or use the date, user, terminal, and status filters.
Click a sale to view the receipt.
Click Re-print Receipt to print it again. Click the invoice icon, then click the Download button to download the PDF.

title: Refund or exchange an item
text: Use Refund to give money back. Use Return to exchange an item for another one.
steps: Click Sidebar > Point of Sale.
Click More Options > View Sales History, then select the sale.
Click Return / Refund.
Choose the quantity to return. Mark each item as Restock or Damaged.
For a refund, click Refund. Choose the payment method and add a reference number if asked.
For an exchange, click Return. Add the replacement items and pay any difference.

title: Cancel a whole receipt
text: Cancel Transaction cancels the whole receipt and returns the items to stock. This cannot be undone.
steps: Click Sidebar > Point of Sale.
Click More Options > View Sales History, then select the sale.
Click Cancel Transaction and enter the reason.
Confirm the cancellation. A manager may need to approve it.
Print the cancellation slip from the next dialog.

title: Cash out and end your shift
text: To close your shift, remove cash from the drawer and run the End Mid (Y) report.
steps: On the register, click More Options > Cash-in/Cash-out.
Click Remove Cash. Enter the amount and reason, then click Save.
Click More Options > Cashier Report.
Click End Mid (Y) and count the cash by denomination. The report shows any overage or shortage.
The report saves and prints. Your store may require you to remove the cash first.

title: X, Y, and Z readings
text: Cashier Report has three readings: X shows current sales, Y closes your shift, and Z closes the business day.
steps: Click Sidebar > Point of Sale.
Click More Options > Cashier Report.
Click Print Sales (X) to view current sales. This does not close anything.
Click End Mid (Y) to close your shift, then count the cash.
Click End of Day (Z) to close the business day. Do this once after the last sale.
Open the History tab to print an earlier reading.

title: Choose which stock batch a sale uses
text: If a product has several batches, you can choose which batch to sell. Turn on this option first.
steps: Click Settings > Cashier Settings > Stock at the Register.
Turn on Enable Inventory Source Selection, then click Save.
On the register, add a product with several batches. The Select Inventory Source window opens.
Choose a batch using its number, expiry date, and quantity. Press Enter.
Products with only one batch do not show this window.

title: Sell at wholesale or another price tier
text: Price Mode lets you choose Retail, Wholesale, or another price tier for the whole cart.
steps: Click Settings > Cashier Settings. Turn on Wholesale & Multi-Price Tiers, then click Save.
On the register, click the Retail/Wholesale switch or Price Mode. You can also press Left Shift.
Choose a price tier. All items in the cart use that tier's price.
If Price Tier Selection is set to ask per item, choose a price in the Price Type window when you add each product.

title: Keyboard shortcuts at the register
text: Use keyboard shortcuts to work at the register without a mouse. Your store can change these shortcuts in the theme customizer.
steps: Press F2 for Discount, F3 for Save Order, F4 for Quantity, and F5 for Payment.
Press F6 for Search, F7 for Customer, F9 for Clear All, F10 for Cash Drawer, and F11 for Fullscreen.
Press Delete to remove the selected cart item. Press Tab to move between the search box and cart.
In search, use the arrow keys to move through results. Press Enter to add the selected product.
